title: Synced
description: Sync inventories, health, hunger, XP, potion effects, ender chests and positions across teams of players, fully configurable via in-game GUI.
body:
# Synced
**Synced** is a Paper plugin that lets players link together in teams and share their game state in real time. When one player in a team takes damage, eats food, gains XP, or picks up items, the change is reflected across every member of the team instantly.

## Features ## 
- Inventory sync — all 36 slots and offhand stay identical across teammates
- Health sync — damage and healing is shared
- Hunger sync — food level, saturation, and exhaustion stay in step
- XP sync — experience points and levels are mirrored
- Potion effects sync — active effects propagate to all members
- Ender chest sync — shared ender chest contents across the team
- Position sync — optional teleporting to keep the team together

## How to use ##
Run /synced start to open the configuration menu. From there you can toggle each sync feature on or off. Invite other players with /synced invite <player> and they join with /synced join <teamname>.

## Commands ##
| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/synced start` | Open the config menu and create your team |
| `/synced invite <player>` | Invite a player to your team |
| `/synced join <name>` | Join a team by name |
| `/synced leave` | Leave your current team |
| `/synced disband` | Disband your team (leader only) |
| `/synced info` | View your team and current settings |

Server-side only, no client mod required
Position sync is disabled by default
All settings are configurable per team via the in-game GUI
